title: Senior Financial Services Analyst
description:
**Business Unit:**
==================


Cubic Transportation Systems**Company Details:**
====================


When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  

  

We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.**Job Details:**
================

**Job Summary**


Responsible for all back\-end settlement transactions and the reporting associated with these tasks including timely reconciliation of all accounts assigned. This position typically works with general supervision and direction. Incumbents of this position will regularly exercise discretionary and substantial decision\-making authority.

**About the Role**


Are you a detail\-oriented financial professional with a passion for data, reconciliation, and process improvement? We’re looking for a Senior Financial Services Analyst to join our dynamic team and play a key role in managing high\-volume settlement transactions and financial reporting. This is a great opportunity for someone with strong accounting fundamentals, analytical skills, and a collaborative mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Accurately settle high\-volume financial transactions and ensure timely reconciliation of assigned accounts.
* Monitor and ensure smooth data transfers between systems such as Microsoft Dynamics, external payment processors, and settlement banks.
* Reconcile directed fund movements with actual results and prepare standard/ad hoc reports on clearing and settlement activity.
* Perform complex data analysis and identifies any financial discrepancies
* Address discrepancies and communicates them with key stakeholders
* Enter and manage debit/credit transactions with precision.
* Investigate chargebacks and coordinate with merchant banks and credit card issuers.
* Assist in preparation of processes and procedures documentation
* Analyze payment processing fees to identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Reconcile General Ledger accounts and support financial close activities.
* Oversee, review, and guide the day\-to\-day activities carried out by the junior team members, ensuring accuracy and adherence to process.

**What We’re Looking For**


We’re seeking candidates who bring more than just experience—they bring energy, curiosity, and a team\-first attitude. The ideal candidate will have:

**Required Qualifications:**

* CA Semi\-Qualified with completed articleship; a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance is an added advantage.
* Minimum 4 years of post\-articleship accounting experience, with a strong working knowledge of debits, credits, and reconciliations.
* At least 1 year of experience in a team handling or supervisory capacity.
* Advanced Excel skills with hands\-on experience managing large datasets; knowledge of Power Query, Pivot Tables, and Power BI is desirable.
* Familiarity with Electronic Funds Movement processes and financial systems.
* Exposure to data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus.
* Strong communication skills with a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to adapt in a dynamic environment.
* Well\-organized, self\-driven, and capable of working independently under general supervision.


‎


**Worker Type:**
================


Employee
‎


*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Why CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO):** When you join CBRE Business services Organization (BSO), you become part of a global leader in commercial real estate and investment services that help businesses and people thrive. At CBRE\- Business services Organization (BSO), We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO), Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people and you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.
  
Job Title – Senior Financial Analyst
  
**About the Role:** The employee will be responsible for managing end to end cash, banking, and related financial operations, ensuring strong governance, accuracy, and compliance across all processes. This role requires a high level of attention to detail, process excellence, and effective collaboration with cross functional teams.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Develop, document, and implement policies, processes, and internal controls related to cash management, banking, and Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable.
  
Manage daily banking operations, including cash/bank reconciliations, expense allocation, and revenue allocation.
  
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Payments, Banking, Treasury, Service Desk, OTC, Project teams, and other internal stakeholders.
  
Perform reconciliation of revenue and expenses across systems, bank statements, and the general ledger.
  
Ensure full compliance with SOX requirements, loss prevention practices, and always maintain audit readiness.
  
Minimize unreconciled items and ensure aged open items from bank reconciliations are addressed promptly.
  
Process, review, and approve journals and requests with 100% accuracy and in accordance with Best in Class (BIC) standards.
  
Involve in Balance Sheet reconciliation preparations and reviews and ensure account reconciliations are prepared and completed with 100% accuracy and high\-quality standards.
  
Execute month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end closing activities, demonstrating a commitment to exceptional delivery.
  
Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations and complete related reporting activities adhering to BIC standards.
  
Manage Pay in Full (PIF) requests and payment voiding activities as required.
  
Identify, propose, and implement process enhancements, best practices, and automation opportunities to improve productivity and output quality.
  
  

**What You'll Need:**  

Bachelor’s degree in accounting; professional certifications are an added advantage.
  
Experience in managing multi site cash and banking operations with diverse income streams.
  
Strong reconciliation capabilities with excellent attention to detail.
  
Proficiency in English, including strong verbal and business writing skills.
  
Effective communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with management across Finance and Business teams.
  
Experience working in a large global organisation and within a matrix structure.
  
Strong business acumen with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  
Solid understanding of finance systems and technical integrations; experience with SAP, AX Dynamics, i\-Scala \& PeopleSoft/MyFinance is an advantage.
  
Willingness to work from the office during the KT and Stabilization phase, followed by hybrid work as per management direction.
  
Commitment to going the extra mile to achieve high\-quality outcomes.
  
Flexibility and adaptability to support management with process improvement, AI, and finance transformation initiatives.
  
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively.
  
  

**Company Perks and benefits:**  

**Health Care:** Health Insurance to Self, Immediate family \& Parents/In\-laws
  
Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees.
  
**Food \& Snacks:** Free Meals \& snacks are provided in all shifts.
  
**Mental Wellbeing:** A confidential service that provides facility of counselling to keep you emotionally \& mentally well while dealing with the challenges.
  
**Child Care:** We partner with Klay day care and CBRE employees get 100% waiver on admission fee. This Day school is in our HYD campus.
  
**Entertainment:** On floor \- Chess, Carrom board, Table tennis, Foosball.
  
**Our Values in Hiring:** At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.
  
CBRE Business Services Organisation (BSO) is a part of CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE): CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S\&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2023 revenue). The company has more than 130,000 employees (including Turner \& Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction, and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services. Please visit our website at www.cbre.com. We routinely post important information on our website, including corporate and investor presentations and financial information. We intend to use our website as a means of disclosing material, non\-public information and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Such disclosures will be included in the Investor Relations section of our website at https://ir.cbre.com. Accordingly, investors should monitor such portion of our website, in addition to following our press releases, Securities and Exchange Commission filings and public conference calls and webcasts.

title: Manager Finance & Accounts
description:
**Job Purpose**

To independently manage and control the company's complete Finance \& Accounting function, including accounting, banking, taxation, working capital, receivables, payables, cash\-flow management, MIS reporting, statutory compliance and financial controls.

The candidate will be responsible for independent financial decision\-making within approved company policies and limits, ensuring accurate accounting, timely statutory compliance, optimum utilization of funds and strong financial discipline across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Finance \& Accounting Management**

Independently manage day\-to\-day Finance \& Finalisation of Accounts operations.  
Reconciliation’s of salary payables and advances, Loans recovery.  
Independently operate and manage Tally Prime accounting software.  
Independently handle the ESI, EPF, PT provisions and implementations in HR Dept.  
Independently manage GST notices, orders, replies, assessments, and demand proceedings.  
Strong knowledge of E\-Way Bill provisions, rules, regulations, and compliance requirements.

**GST, TDS \& Statutory Compliance**

Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements.

Review GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-2B reconciliation, annual GST returns, GST input tax credit, e\-invoicing, e\-way bills and debit/credit notes.

Review TDS applicability and deductions under applicable sections.

Ensure timely TDS payments and returns.

Reconcile TDS records with books and relevant portals.

Coordinate with CA/Tax Consultant for assessments, notices and statutory matters.

Maintain proper documentation for tax audits and statutory audits.

**Required Skills \& Knowledge**

Strong knowledge of Finalization of Accounting Operations.

Advanced knowledge of Tally Prime Edit log.

Strong knowledge of Banking Operations.

Strong knowledge of GST and TDS.  
Strong Knowledge in salary reconciliations/advance/loans (recovery concept)  
Strong Knowledge in Provision for taxation, advance tax, Tds receivable.  
**Preferred:** Construction/project accounting, industrial/service industry, project\-wise costing, ERP/accounting software, banking limits and working\-capital facilities, Bank Guarantee/LC knowledge, audit handling and experience dealing directly with CA, auditors, banks and tax consultants.

**Educational Qualification:**

Mandatory: B. Com / M. Com / CA Inter or equivalent qualification.

Preferred: CA / CMA / ACCA qualification or equivalent professional exposure with relevant exposure.

**Experience**

Minimum: 6 years relevant experience.

Preferred: 6 – 10\+ years.

The candidate should have previously handled Finance \& Accounts with independent responsibility rather than only performing data\-entry/accounting\-executive functions.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on Finance \& Accounts Manager who can independently take ownership of the Finance Department.

The ideal candidate should be commercially minded, analytical, responsible and capable of making practical financial decisions. The person should not be limited to bookkeeping and should have the ability to understand the complete business cycle from Purchase → Inventory/Project → Sales → Receivables → Banking → Cash Flow → Profitability.

The candidate must be comfortable dealing independently with Management, Banks, Customers, Vendors, Auditors, CA/Tax Consultants and internal departments.

Core Competencies: Accounting \+ Banking \+ Taxation \+ Tally Prime \+ Working Capital \+ MIS \+ Commercial Understanding \+ Team Management \+ Decision Making.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
